title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.

title: Thavarige Baa Thangi
desc: Lakshmi faces trouble when her in-laws hurl a false accusation at her. However, Lakshmi's brother is determined to stand by her side.

title: Yare Nee Abhimani
desc: Adithya, a writer, falls for Utthara after reading her letter but mistakenly believes Prajna is Utthara when they meet, leading him to propose to her, which sparks a complicated love triangle.

title: Don Seenu
desc: Inspired by Amitabh Bachchan's Don, a fan sets out to make a name for himself in the underworld. However, a case of mistaken identity may turn this endeavour into a comedy of errors.

title: Sampathige Saval
desc: Siddappa, a cruel landlord, refuses to pay the funeral expenses of his servant after his accidental death. Angered by the betrayal, the worker's son, Veerabhadra, grows up to resent Siddappa.
